change: Add deadline-bounded SharedChannel control-plane admission across State and connectivity Tracker locks

reference.observed_contract: channel control-plane updates are serialized through WorkSerializer ownership, shutdown suppresses later updates, and surface observers retain independent references

before.state_control: connect, endpoint count and endpoint watch initialization only exposed unbounded State admission
before.tracker_control: connectivity snapshot and Watch initialization only exposed unbounded Tracker admission
before.nested_connect: connect separately snapshotted and updated aggregate connectivity, permitting a second unbounded Tracker lock after State admission
before.risk: a control-plane caller could exceed its budget before receiving a cursor or publishing demand

interop.held_state: unary, duplex startup, resolution refresh, connect, endpoint count and endpoint watch each exhaust a 10 ms deadline without releasing the fixture mutex
interop.held_tracker: nested connect, connectivity snapshot and Watch initialization each exhaust a 10 ms deadline without releasing the fixture mutex
interop.continuation: after unlock the same channel completes resolution, health, shared calls, operation deadlines, cancellation reuse and soak
